scope: Main game index.html + script.js (なおとっち). Tracks in audio.js: home, night, game, movie, puzzle, race, sports, farewell (audio.js:95-206).

order: state.stage DEAD or FAREWELL, or lifeCardOverlay visible -> farewell
gameActive -> genre: drive3d->race, puzzle/board->puzzle, sports->sports, else game (quick run -> game)
currentScene_logic.gameActive_set: true only in startMinigame (script.js:17927); false in closeMinigameScreen (script.js:17607)
currentScene_logic.dateOpen_set: true in openDateChooser (script.js:9986), playOrdinaryDateMovie (10032), playMarriageMovie (10088), playLegendEncounterMovie (10230); false at 10002, 13094, 19705
currentScene_logic.not_covered_by_logic: region, daypart, weather, season, menus, meguru, egg, transform, companion/partner events, birthday, game clear (dex/perfect) all fall through to home (or night if sleeping).
currentScene_logic.time_scale: TICK_MS=3000 (script.js:67); AGE_TICKS_PER_YEAR=20 -> 1 age-year = 60 s, 100 years = 100 min (script.js:100). Age stops while menu overlays are open (script.js:93-99 comment).

screens_and_events.trigger: default; screenNormal
new life starts as STAGE.EGG; hatches when growth >= HATCH_GROWTH(20)
hatchEgg(): SFX 'hatch', message, birth-celebration stars
onAgeChanged when age +1 without stage change -> onBirthday(): birthdayToast '🎂 Nさいになった'
screens_and_events.duration: toast 1200 ms; every 60 s of play

screens_and_events.trigger: maybeMidlifeEvent on age change; showStoryEvent

screens_and_events.id: growth / stage-up (成長・すがたがかわった)
screens_and_events.trigger: onStageChanged when age crosses a life-stage boundary (8 stages per species): message + showStoryEvent 'Nさいになった！<stage>' + emote 'fun' (SFX chirp) + speakEvent('evolve')
gainSodachi(): SFX 'levelup' per point
offerTransformIfReady when transformMeter>=100 (on stage change, birthday, after minigame, game pass); transformOverlay 'すがたをえらべるよ!' shown while state.transformOptions
screens_and_events.duration: screen the player stays on until choosing (blocks menus and minigames)

screens_and_events.id: companion invite (なかまの さそい)
screens_and_events.trigger: scheduleCompanionEncounter every ~90-240 s (90% chance) when idle; also from item tickets

screens_and_events.id: lover / partner start (こいびとになった)
screens_and_events.trigger: courtBtn (きゅうあい) success roll with candidate
courtBtn with partner; bondCount reaches marriageBondThreshold -> reinforceRelationship married=true; message '💍 …とけっこんした' + speakEvent('marriage') + emote love

screens_and_events.id: anniversary movie (ふたりのきねんび)
screens_and_events.trigger: checkMarriageMilestones at marriageAge+1/10/25/50 years -> playMarriageMovie
screens_and_events.duration: fullscreen movie, 4000 ms per beat (~5-8 beats, ~20-35 s) then close button

screens_and_events.id: date chooser (デートをえらぼう)
screens_and_events.trigger: worldDateBtn in せかい screen (requires そだち50 perk & partner)
goOnDate(plan) -> playOrdinaryDateMovie; plans walk/lost/shop/nap/rain/star/sunset/photo/eat (+deepsea variant)
screens_and_events.duration: fullscreen movie 3500 ms per beat (~20-30 s), skip/close

screens_and_events.id: legend encounter movie (でんせつのであい)
screens_and_events.trigger: maybeLegendEncounter each tick after そだち70, once per life, not during minigame/sleep/menus
INDIVIDUALITY pending events at ages
sleepBtn toggles state.isSleeping; SFX sleep/wake
screens_and_events.duration: stays until player presses おきる (no automatic wake found)

screens_and_events.trigger: triggerDeath(): stage DEAD, SFX 'die' (unless いのちのおまもり)

screens_and_events.id: farewell / さいごのじかん (100さい)
screens_and_events.trigger: enterFarewell at GOAL_AGE 100: stage FAREWELL, farewellBar shown, grandGoalPending='life'

screens_and_events.id: life card (いっしょうカード)
screens_and_events.trigger: farewellBtn or automatically after death
grandGoalPending: 'life' (100さい; tiers ①てんじゅ ②たくさんそだった ③…), 'dex' (④ずかん complete), 'perfect' (⑤all achievements); gameClearOverlay renderEnding with art assets/clear/goal-N
screens_and_events.duration: screen until close; dex/perfect then showAuthorGreeting (ナオト), perfect can enter ♾️ mode
screens_and_events.track: farewell for 'life' (stage FAREWELL); home for 'dex'/'perfect' (stage GROWING) - a gap

screens_and_events.trigger: gameClearFreePlayBtn after perfect
playBtn/games list -> tryStartPlay -> startMinigame

screens_and_events.id: minigame help (そうさのせつめい)
screens_and_events.trigger: ？そうさ during a game
finishMinigame -> closeMinigameScreen (gameActive=false) -> showMinigameResultToast; SFX fanfare (S/A) / fail (D) / clear
screens_and_events.duration: toast 3600 ms (6000 ms with retry button)
